mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fgc.cap_check ( validation_run_id, contract_id, payment_stage, cap_rule_set_id, refund_rate_table_id, check_kind, as_of_date, base_premium_amount, refund_12m_amount, compliance_deduction_amount, limit_amount, included_amount, remaining_amount, usage_pct, result_status, calculation_snapshot ) VALUES ( #{validationRunId}, #{contractId}, #{paymentStage}, #{capRuleSetId}, #{refundRateTableId}, #{checkKind}, #{asOfDate}, #{basePremiumAmount}, #{refund12mAmount}, #{complianceDeductionAmount}, #{limitAmount}, #{includedAmount}, #{remainingAmount}, #{usagePct}, #{resultStatus}, COALESCE(#{calculationSnapshotJson}, '{}')::jsonb )

INSERT INTO fgc.cap_check_detail ( cap_check_id, detail_seq, commission_item_id, schedule_line_id, classification_snapshot, amount, decision_reason ) VALUES
(#{d.capCheckId}, #{d.detailSeq}, #{d.commissionItemId}, #{d.scheduleLineId}, #{d.classificationSnapshot}, #{d.amount}, #{d.decisionReason})
mapper.select: SELECT cc.cap_check_id AS capCheckId, cc.contract_id AS contractId, cc.payment_stage AS paymentStage, cc.check_kind AS checkKind, cc.as_of_date AS asOfDate, cc.cap_rule_set_id AS capRuleSetId, cc.refund_rate_table_id AS refundRateTableId, cc.base_premium_amount AS basePremiumAmount, cc.refund_12m_amount AS refund12mAmount, cc.compliance_deduction_amount AS complianceDeductionAmount, cc.limit_amount AS limitAmount, cc.included_amount AS includedAmount, cc.remaining_amount AS remainingAmount, cc.usage_pct AS usagePct, cc.result_status AS resultStatus, cc.calculation_snapshot::text AS calculationSnapshotJson FROM fgc.cap_check cc WHERE cc.contract_id = #{contractId} AND cc.payment_stage = #{paymentStage} ORDER BY cc.checked_at DESC, cc.cap_check_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT cc.cap_check_id AS capCheckId, cc.contract_id AS contractId, ic.contract_no AS contractNo, cc.payment_stage AS paymentStage, cc.as_of_date AS asOfDate, cc.base_premium_amount AS basePremiumAmount, cc.refund_12m_amount AS refund12mAmount, cc.compliance_deduction_amount AS complianceDeductionAmount, cc.limit_amount AS limitAmount, cc.included_amount AS includedAmount, cc.remaining_amount AS remainingAmount, cc.usage_pct AS usagePct, cc.result_status AS resultStatus, cc.cap_rule_set_id AS capRuleSetId FROM fgc.cap_check cc JOIN fgc.insurance_contract ic ON ic.contract_id = cc.contract_id
ORDER BY cc.as_of_date DESC, cc.cap_check_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fgc.cap_check cc JOIN fgc.insurance_contract ic ON ic.contract_id = cc.contract_id

SELECT ccd.detail_seq AS detailSeq, ccd.commission_item_id AS commissionItemId, ci.item_code AS itemCode, ci.item_name AS itemName, ccd.schedule_line_id AS scheduleLineId, sl.contract_month_no AS contractMonthNo, ccd.classification_snapshot AS classification, ccd.amount AS amount, ccd.decision_reason AS decisionReason, ccd.evidence_ref AS evidenceRef FROM fgc.cap_check_detail ccd JOIN fgc.commission_item ci ON ci.commission_item_id = ccd.commission_item_id JOIN fgc.schedule_line sl ON sl.schedule_line_id = ccd.schedule_line_id WHERE ccd.cap_check_id = #{capCheckId} ORDER BY ccd.detail_seq
